overview.description: The Canary Marinade Solana ETF (SOLC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sol, short usd currency. The fund aims to track the spot price performance of Solana (SOL), less fees and expenses. The Trust holds Solana, the native cryptocurrency of the Solana blockchain. SOLC was launched on Nov 18, 2025 and is issued by Canary.

data.title: Canary Capital Launches Canary Marinade Solana ETF (SOLC), Giving Investors Simple Access to Solana and Staking Rewards Potential
data.text: BRENTWOOD, Tenn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)---- $SOLC #ETF--Canary Capital expands crypto ETF product suite with launch of Canary Marinade Solana ETF, offering investors a new way to invest in Solana.
